course:
This is an involved course that requires a lot of study, but I don't think it is difficult. Zeki Kuruoğlu does his best to provide all of the mathematical knowledge that is required for the subject and that the students might not have. If you follow classes regularly and do your homeworks, you will find the exams very doable and the subject understandable--and even quite enjoyable.
One improvement might be to schedule homeworks so that they are not back to back, with only one week in between. Homeworks take a long time and doing one every week can be very tiring, especially with other midterms, reports etc. coming up. The homeworks do however fulfill their purpose of making students study and understand the material before the week of the midterm.
Good

Hoca dersi oldukça sistematik ve iyi anlatıyor. Dersteki konseptler zor olmasına rağmen bence ana fikri verme noktasında oldukça başarılı. Dersi kendisinden aldığım için memnunum.
The professor treats students with highest respect and genuinely cares for their wellbeing.
course: The course is very straightforward and the homework and exams were very improving for us. But the "revision of thermodynamics" part was unnecessarily long, we could only start the real course material after the first midterm.

s: Important mandatory course.
w: In the first month of the course we reviewed thermodynamics. It would be better if the thermodynamics course was a pre-requisite for this course so that we would have more time to cover some more advanced topics at the end of the semester.

There is too much information concentrated into a single course. It's exceedingly difficult to use external sources to help understand the topics as the notation and progression is unique. Speaking of external sources, the 25 points worth of homeworks are instantly uploaded to Chegg by some irresponsible student, this is a curved course.
assistant: The assistant graded the homeworks and provided feedback.  He did well.

instructor: Dersler ruhumu emiyordu. Hayatımda bu kadar çok sıkıldığım başka bir an olduğunu sanmıyorum. Derslerde hiçbir şey öğrenmedim. Sınavlara ödevlerde verilen soruları ezberleyerek girdim. Çoğu şeyin ne işe yaradığını nereden geldiğini bilmiyorum. Ayrıca Zeki Hocanın bizim kimyacı değil fizikçi olduğumuz gerçeğini anlaması gerek. Dönem boyunca kimyacılarla aynı ödevleri aynı sınavları çözdük
+ Zeki Hoca bu dersi alabileceğiniz en iyi hocadır herhalde. Konuya oldukça hakim, sorduğunuz soruları da ziyadesiyle cevaplayabiliyor. Öğrencilerle de iletişimden kaçınmıyor kendisi.
Hoca derse dair bazı önemli anektodlarda vurgu yapsa çok iyi olur. Bazen önemli bir şey söylerken vurgusunu yapmadığı için konunun mantığına dair şeyleri kaçırıyoruz.

He explains the subject very clearly and sometimes refers to some related advanced topics; which motivates me. However his speaking is very hard to hear and his handwriting is very small to see. If you, somehow, manage to focus your sense organs on him you are going to get a solid understanding of the subject.
He is a kind and understanding professor. His lecturing style is too monotonic and it's hard to focus during lectures.
Hocamız biraz yaşlanmış!!!   :(
Sometimes it can be hard to focus on the class but I think he explains many things very clearly.

good
Asistan Sercan, adaletli bir şekilde not dağıtıyor. İyi bir insan.

instructor: Zeki Cemal Hoca's way of teaching this class is not by showing the concepts behind it. He uses mathematics very rigidly as if it were a mathematics class. At first, especially in Thermodynamics, I thought I would not learn anything, just memorize stuff to pass the exams. However, I believe that rigidly showing mathematics actually works better for statistical physics. I've liked to link the concepts in my head after learning the mathematical tools well.

Well-organized, attentive, and speaks very good English. Unfortunately could not stimulate much interest. He speaks very monotonically, often gazes out the windows, and does not promote students' participation to the lecture.
course: Very important, yet poorly taught subject. The meaning behind the statistical mechanics calculations we make, or behind our methods are hardly made clear. Historical development of the subject is almost never spoken of. It feels like a repetition of the same physical concepts with the same mathematics for several weeks. Three (seemingly) slightly different ensemble approaches, ten weeks. Simply too much and unnecessary IMO.
assistant: Worst TA I've seen. I am very doubtful they even know statistical physics. Maybe they are throwing dice to give the grades. There is hardly any feedback, just 0 points for solutions when they are not bothered to understand it.
